name: Git Workflow Enhanced
author: Axiom Team
description: Advanced Git workflow automation with branch naming, commit message generation, PR template, and changelog management
readme:
# Git Workflow Enhanced Plugin

Deterministic text/template generation from the arguments you pass in — no filesystem or
git access, and nothing is written to disk.

- Smart branch naming from task descriptions
- Conventional commit message generation
- PR template generation
- Changelog entry formatting (returns the entry text; it does not write CHANGELOG.md)

Audit note (2026-09-14): the manifest previously also declared `manage_git_hooks`, which
had **no implementation at all** — a phantom interface. That declaration was removed so the
manifest matches the four tools the plugin actually registers.
